data.gist: BMAX-derived adherent cells formed more colonies than BMAC; MSC marker percentage was similar at P0, but CD146+CD45− (pericyte-like) cells rose over passages and were significantly higher at P2 in BMAX.
data.plain: Cells that stuck to culture plates from the BMAX preparation formed more colonies over 14 days than those from BMAC. Standard stem cell surface markers were similar at the start, but a pericyte-like subset (CD146-positive, CD45-negative) became enriched with repeated passaging and was significantly higher in BMAX by passage 2.
